summaries.en: The Blue House reaffirmed that despite controversies surrounding Justice Minister nominee Kim Seung-won and Gender Equality and Family Minister nominee Yong Hye-in, both must undergo confirmation hearings as a "public verification process."
summaries.zh: 韩国总统府重申，尽管围绕法务部长提名人金承源和性别平等与家庭部长提名人龙慧仁存在争议，两人仍需接受人事听证会，并强调这是“国民验证过程”。
